product_one_liner.value: Authentic8’s Silo Workspace gives government and commercial intelligence, security and investigative teams an isolated, anonymous environment to investigate the web, collect evidence and analyze findings.

named_customers.notes: MindPoint Group SOC is explicitly named as a user; the reviewed additional case studies and testimonials anonymize customers. Fewer than two customer organization names were verified, so the list is empty under the requested rule.

employee_band.notes: Reported workforce count: 124; mapped to the requested band.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index and engineering-related search results show investigative guidance, product updates and marketing rather than two engineer-authored accounts of how the product is built.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Governance Administration Specialist and Sales Development Representative, Commercial; neither qualifies.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product documentation, AI FAQ, blog, assurance and privacy material. Public descriptions refer to external/public AI models without naming the provider; no public AI subprocessor list naming one was located.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the company’s public claims; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not independently issued certifications in the same sense as ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: The investor announcement dates the debt facility October 8, 2025; this primary-source date takes precedence over conflicting profile dates.

raised_18mo.notes: US$12 million debt financing announced October 8, 2025, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative, Commercial opening.

launched_6mo.notes: Nexus AI v2 was announced August 19, 2026 and released August 20, adding investigation roles, expanded file analysis and workflow integrations.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Miguel Ramos’s profile dates his move from Head of Product to Chief Product Officer to January 2026, but he had already worked at Authentic8 since 2019. This establishes an internal promotion, not a company join or departure. The leadership page does not provide enough start dates to establish a negative for the full team, and no qualifying join or departure was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly names Salesforce for activity and opportunity tracking.
